name: GWAAN-1
author: FEDLIC TOKYO
tagline: an ambient drone synth: slow FM swells and deep sub fields, steered by knobs
description: GWAAN-1 turns the FM-1 into an ambient drone machine that plays itself from power-on. A gliding FM voice (mihyon), a sub drone whose chord fields crossfade every 35-50 seconds (guwaan), filtered-noise air with rare water drops, and since v0.2 a distant beacon: soft sine pings in morse-like patterns, washed in echo. Five scenes (DEEP, FOREST, RAIN, STARS, DAWN) and knob macros for glide, depth, space and drift. v0.2.1: the knobs answer immediately, and SELECT is a true resonant filter. Smoothed and limited: never harsh.
credits: Built on fm1-base (Charles Vestal, MPL-2.0) and felucca-bsp. App code by FEDLIC TOKYO, MIT.
